The entire lower inner arch is dark stone with no new window, door, opening or added joint grid. Preserve the existing blue-water boundary and restrained reflected shapes; do not add white foam, decorative ripples, fish or boats. Smooth clean gray stone with gentle tonal planes and minimal brush texture, not stains or scratches. No duplicated pillars or added rail holes. Image1 alone controls structure. Reconstruct the top/left soft guide transitions into coherent shading without horizontal or vertical compositing bars. Return this exact close crop only.
